messages.text: Constitution Hill set for serious test at Kempton on Saturday

metadata.summary: Constitution Hill looks likely to face a serious examination of his big-race ambitions on the Flat when he goes for the William Hill September Stakes at Kempton Park on Saturday, with new jockey Billy Loughnane in the saddle.
metadata.content: Constitution Hill set for serious test at Kempton on Saturday | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Constitution Hill set for serious test at Kempton on Saturday The September Stakes is set to pose a very different question of Constitution Hill with top-class rivals Gethin, Bay City Roller and Tornado Alert all set to face Nicky Henderson's star Monday 31 August 2026 18:15, UK Image: Ryan Moore was drafted in to ride Constitution Hill at Kempton in place of the suspended Oisin Murphy Constitution Hill looks likely to face a serious examination of his big-race ambitions on the Flat when he goes for the William Hill September Stakes at Kempton Park on Saturday, with new jockey Billy Loughnane in the saddle. Nicky Henderson's former superstar hurdler is two from two since switching to the level, but the Group Three contest at the Sunbury track represents a major step up. The nine-year-old has been ridden by Oisin Murphy and Ryan Moore so far in his new adventure, but Loughnane's name appeared alongside the Seven Barrows runner for the weekend on the British Horseracing Authority administration site. Aventure ends Diamond Necklace's unbeaten record Notable Speech clinches City Of York crown for Appleby Loughnane's agent Tony Hind, who also represents Moore, confirmed the switch saying that Henderson was happy for the championship-leading jockey to take over on Michael Buckley's pride and joy. metadata.summary: Britain's Toby Samuel has come a long way from the start of 2025 - rising from 1,871 in the world to the US Open second round.
metadata.content: US Open: Britain's Toby Samuel's meteoric rise from world No 1,871 and playing in Guatemala to the US Open second round | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open: Britain's Toby Samuel's meteoric rise from world No 1,871 and playing in Guatemala to the US Open second round Britain's Toby Samuel is into the second round at Flushing Meadows where he takes on Czech 18th seed Jiri Lehecka; watch the US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app By Raz Mirza at Flushing Meadows, New York Monday 31 August 2026 17:50, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player British qualifier Toby Samuel claimed his first Grand Slam main-draw victory with an impressive straight-sets win over Tomas Machac Britain's Toby Samuel has come a long way from the start of 2025 - rising from 1,871 in the world to the US Open second round. Samuel, who came through qualifying to make his main draw debut at Flushing Meadows, needed just an hour and 32 minutes to beat the former world No 20 Tomas Machac and book his place in the second round. The 23-year-old - dubbed the 'Winchester Rifle' due to his powerful serve - hammered down serves of up to 135mph to blow his Czech opponent away. messages.text: MCC taking action over Lord's pitch after 'reputational blow'

metadata.summary: The MCC has outlined an action plan to address concerns over the pitch at Lord's, with it having been deemed "unsatisfactory" by the ICC.
metadata.content: Lord's pitch: MCC outlines action plan after England vs Pakistan Test to address criticism of playing surface | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Lord's pitch: MCC outlines action plan after England vs Pakistan Test to address criticism of playing surface Lord's pitch was rated 'unsatisfactory' and given demerit point after second-shortest Test match in ground's history earlier this summer; watch the third Test between England and Pakistan, at Edgbaston, live on Sky Sports from Wednesday, September 9 Monday 31 August 2026 16:52, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Eoin Morgan reacts to the MCC's proposed improvements at Lord's after concerns were raised over the quality of the pitch in recent matches The MCC has outlined an action plan to address concerns over the pitch at Lord's, with it having been deemed "unsatisfactory" by the ICC. Lord's was handed one demerit point under the ICC's Pitch and Outfield Monitoring Process after the staging of its 150th Test match between England and New Zealand earlier this summer proved to be the ground's second-shortest on record at 165 overs and two-and-a-half days' action. The playing surface was back under the spotlight this week, with stats showing that there was actually more movement on offer for bowlers during England's 194-run victory over Pakistan than in the prior Test against New Zealand. messages.text: Messi retires from international football: 'I have nothing left to give'

metadata.summary: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football aged 39.
metadata.content: Lionel Messi retires from international football aged 39 as Argentina's most-capped player and all-time leading goalscorer | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Lionel Messi retires from international football aged 39 as Argentina's most-capped player and all-time leading goalscorer Lionel Messi announces retirement from international football aged 39, after leading Argentina to this summer's World Cup final; Messi leaves as Argentina's most-capped and highest-scoring player, and said passing of father Jorge on August 8 had made him "more convinced" to retire Monday 31 August 2026 18:10, UK Image: Lionel Messi celebrates with the World Cup trophy after Argentina's triumph in 2022 Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football aged 39. The eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, who captained his country to the World Cup in 2022, showed his enduring quality as he again led them to the final of the World Cup this summer. But 21 years on from his first appearance he has called time on his international career, leaving a record-breaking legacy of 125 goals from 207 games. No Argentine has played or scored more for their country. He retires having won every possible competition in international football, after twice winning the Copa America in 2021 and 2024, lifting the World Cup in Qatar and captaining Argentina to victory in the inaugural Finalissima in 2022. metadata.content: Women’s TGL: Five line-ups for inaugural season unveiled with Charley Hull and Lexi Thompson among big names | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Women’s TGL: Five line-ups for inaugural season unveiled with Charley Hull and Lexi Thompson among big names WTGL will take place at SoFi centre in Florida, the same venue which has hosted the men's competition since its inaugural season in 2025; England's Charley Hull and world No 2 Jeeno Thitikul are among the players to be named in the five founding teams By Natasha Everitt Monday 31 August 2026 17:38, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Take a look at Tiger Woods' best shots as he made his TGL comeback during Jupiter Links GC's defeat to Los Angeles Golf Club The Women's TGL has confirmed the complete rosters for its five founding teams ahead of the league launch in November. Created by golf icons Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy's TMRW Sports, who launched the men's TGL in 2025, alongside the LPGA at the start of the year, 25 players including Charley Hull and Jeeno Thitikul have been split into five teams of five. The teams boast 48 combined Solheim Cup team appearances including eight selections for the 2026 competition and 15 major championships. They also have a combined 28 Olympic appearances, representing 13 countries.
